name: Shrimp-cake noodles
summary: Bún suông is a breakfast noodle bowl sold on the Hậu landing and at Chợ Châu Đốc, next to hủ tiếu and bún mắm. Down the delta in Trà Vinh, the same bowl is rice noodles and fresh shrimp cake in a pork-bone broth.
origin: A morning bowl on the Châu Đốc riverfront. The shrimp-cake description comes from VnExpress’s Trà Vinh list, not a Châu Đốc recipe.
howToEat: Order it in the morning with the other landing bowls.
In Trà Vinh, VnExpress says the broth is pork bones, sometimes with dried shrimp or dried squid. The sides there are shredded cabbage, onion, coriander, ground-soybean sauce, lime, and chili.
where: Along the Hậu landing and at Chợ Châu Đốc, at breakfast.
seoDescription: Bún suông is a breakfast noodle bowl on the Châu Đốc riverfront and at the market, sold beside hủ tiếu and bún mắm.
